description.name: WHMCS Telegram Pro
description.tagline: Clear, reliable WHMCS notifications in Telegram
description.long: Telegram notification provider for WHMCS. Sends invoice, ticket, order, service, domain and client events with the key details, a link back to WHMCS, per-chat duplicate prevention, a server-side diagnostics panel and a size-capped error log. Failed sends never interrupt WHMCS.
features: Invoice, ticket and order details from the WHMCS database
Professional, Detailed, Compact and Custom message formats
Silent notifications and per-rule chat IDs
